method: Read complete extracted/scythe-rules.txt and only the frozen summary, questions.json, answer-key.json and both reader JSONs from this iteration. No other iterations, grades or reports consulted. Correct requires every requested material fact and no wrong ruling/contradictory caveat; partial means a missing/unresolved requested fact without contradiction; incorrect means material source contradiction. Extra key details not asked are not mandatory; each answer independently graded; self-reported support labels do not determine grades.

results.question: How are Factory cards, encounter tokens, and the structure bonus set up, and who starts?

reader-a.reason: Factory selection/unseen return, encounter count, random face-up structure tile and starting player/direction all resolved.
reader-a.answer_evidence: Shuffle Factory cards, select players + 1 face-down, place them on the board, and return the rest to the box without looking. Put one encounter token on each of the 11 marked territories. Randomly select one structure bonus tile and place it face-up below the Popularity Track. The lowest-numbered Player Mat starts; turns proceed clockwise.

reader-b.reason: Factory selection/unseen return, encounter count, random face-up structure tile and starting player/direction all resolved.
reader-b.answer_evidence: Shuffle the Factory deck, select players + 1 cards face-down onto the board, and return the others to the box without looking. Put one randomly selected structure bonus tile face-up below the Popularity Track and place encounter tokens on each of the 11 marked territories. The lowest-numbered Player Mat starts; then play proceeds clockwise.

results.question: On a normal unupgraded Move, can one unit move twice, can a transported worker subsequently move, and who can carry what?

reader-a.reason: Two different units, carried-worker subsequent movement and all carriage categories resolved. The unasked coin alternative is not mandatory.
reader-a.answer_evidence: On an unupgraded Move, you may move up to two different units one adjacent territory each; you cannot move one unit twice. All units can carry any number of resources. Only mechs may also carry any number of your workers, never your character. A worker carried by a mech may subsequently move itself; a worker may also board a mech before its later move.

reader-b.reason: Two different units, carried-worker subsequent movement and all carriage categories resolved. The unasked coin alternative is not mandatory.
reader-b.answer_evidence: No. A normal Move selects up to two different units, each moving one adjacent territory, and the same unit cannot use both selections to move twice. A transported worker can subsequently move itself, or move onto a mech and be carried by its later move. All units (characters, mechs, workers) can carry any number of resources; only mechs can also carry any number of your workers, never your character.

results.question: When enlisting, where does the token go, what are the one-time bonuses, which action sets ongoing bonus, and how do simultaneous/two-player bonuses resolve?

reader-a.reason: Permanent open Faction-Mat placement, four one-time bonuses, source of ongoing bonus, active/left/right order, sixth-star cutoff and two-player once-only rule resolved. Unasked food payment and announcement are not mandatory.
reader-a.answer_evidence: Enlist costs food. Take a recruit from any bottom-row section and place it permanently on any open one-time bonus space on your Faction Mat; immediately gain two power, two coins, two popularity, or two combat cards. The ongoing bonus is the circle uncovered at the recruit's former Player Mat position, regardless of the one-time bonus chosen. It triggers when you or either immediate neighbor takes that corresponding bottom-row action, not for top actions, encounters, or similar Factory actions. Resolve active player, then left neighbor, then right neighbor; stop if a sixth star ends the game. In a two-player game the opponent triggers it once, not twice. The four ongoing bonuses are Upgrade: one power; Deploy: one coin; Build: one popularity; Enlist: one combat card.

reader-b.reason: Permanent open Faction-Mat placement, four one-time bonuses, source of ongoing bonus, active/left/right order, sixth-star cutoff and two-player once-only rule resolved. Unasked food payment and announcement are not mandatory.
reader-b.answer_evidence: Take a recruit from any bottom-row section of the Player Mat and put it permanently on any open one-time bonus space on the Faction Mat; immediately gain two power, two coins, two popularity, or two combat cards. The ongoing bonus is set by the circle uncovered where the recruit was removed, independent of the chosen one-time bonus: Upgrade gives one power, Deploy one coin, Build one popularity, Enlist one combat card.
